build_IFPipeline: build a DeepFloyd IF text-to-image pipeline using IFPipeline.from_pretrained with fp16 dtype
run_IFPipeline_call: run the IFPipeline to generate images from a text prompt with classifier-free guidance
create_encode_prompt: create prompt embeddings by encoding text prompts into T5 hidden states with optional negative prompts
refactor_clean_caption: refactor the clean_caption method to preprocess and sanitize text captions removing URLs HTML and special characters
test_run_safety_checker: test the safety checker to detect NSFW content and watermarks on generated images
